C1121.title: Hidden Prompts in 18 arXiv Manuscripts Target AI-Assisted Peer Review
C1121.summary: In July 2025, researchers found 18 academic manuscripts on arXiv containing hidden prompts designed to manipulate AI-assisted peer review. Some instructions were concealed as white text and told models to give only positive reviews. A commentary published that month identified four types of self-serving prompts, rejected the claimed honeypot rationale as inadequate, and recommended technical screening at submission portals and harmonized publisher policies for AI-assisted review.
